name: THEMIS
summary: A torque-controlled research humanoid built around Westwood's own BEAR actuators — back-drivable electromechanical units that keep the joints compliant, so the robot yields to contact instead of fighting it. The V2 revision added 7-DOF arms and liquid-cooled hip actuators with more torque and far less waste heat.
notable: Built on in-house back-drivable BEAR actuators
